cases.purpose: Record actual mmap, mlock, munlock and munmap entry/exit events around a bounded try-lock small operation. Use guarded exact-child lifecycle controls and PTRACE_O_EXITKILL.
cases.oracle: An independent libc mmap/mlock/munlock/munmap probe validates the owned-child ptrace observer and a deliberately altered unmap result is rejected before the candidate runs.
cases.comparison: Trace exact syscall numbers, arguments, addresses, return values, error flags and descriptor marker bytes; require absent mappings on precheck or matching ordered lock/unlock/unmap on operation paths. Retain pre-cleanup failure, pidfd, wait/signal, descriptor and cleanup observations.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
/bin/cp /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/trace-vm-mlock-observer-r2.py ./trace-vm-mlock-observer-r2.py
/bin/chmod 0755 ./trace-vm-mlock-observer-r2.py
/bin/cp /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/trace-vm-supervisor-r2.py ./trace-vm-supervisor-r2.py
/bin/chmod 0755 ./trace-vm-supervisor-r2.py
./trace-vm-supervisor-r2.py --selftest
./trace-vm-mlock-observer-r2.py --control
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
./trace-vm-mlock-observer-r2.py small
rc=$?
exit "$rc"
